subject: Request: deploy authorization evidence and secret rotation logistics
messages:
From: Alice Lane <alice.lane@finbank.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Evidence — deploy authorization + secret rotation plan

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG/SOC2 walkthrough we need a focused evidence set showing how Redwood:
- gates deployments (who can approve a production deploy, how approvals are recorded)
- enforces PR/code review and commit authorship (branch protection exports, CODEOWNERS, enforcement settings)
- manages ephemeral CI credentials and secret rotation (CI job examples, token TTLs, KMS rotation cadence)
- maintains a deploy safelist / allowlist for infra changes (snapshot of current safelist)

Can you provide the artifacts below by end of day Monday?
1) Branch protection export and CODEOWNERS snapshot
2) One representative CI run demonstrating ephemeral credentials being minted and then revoked
3) Deploy safelist snapshot and the audit record for the last rollout
4) High-level table mapping who may approve deploys and the approval trail (ticket ids acceptable)

If any of these are sensitive, a redacted export + hashes is fine; we just need provenance and evidence of enforcement.

Let me know if you prefer a shared Drive folder or an upload link.

Regards,
Alice Lane
Senior Information Security Assessor
FinBank Security Team

[Attachment: assessor_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Lane <alice.lane@finbank.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence — deploy authorization + secret rotation plan

Hi Alice — thanks for the checklist and the clarity. We can provide the items you listed; summary and delivery plan below.

Quick answers (summary):
- Branch protections + CODEOWNERS: enforced on protected branches; org policy requires 1+ approver from CODEOWNERS and passing CI checks. Will export latest policy.
- PR review provenance: commit authorship and signed commits are enforced for protected repositories where required; we will include the PR metadata export (author, reviewers, timestamps).
- CI ephemeral creds: our CI uses short-lived tokens from our vault broker (default TTL 10m for runner tokens). We will include one anonymized CI run that shows token issuance and revoke events.
- KMS rotation: customer KMS integrations default to quarterly rotation; for our managed keys we rotate per the rotation schedule (attached summary).
- Deploy safelist: we maintain a JSON safelist for infra actions and a human-reviewed change ticket requirement; snapshot will be provided.

Delivery plan:
- Today: index PDF (sdlc_evidence_index.pdf) with pointers and allowed redactions, and HubSpot deal link for tracking.
- Tomorrow morning (by 08:30 PT): package with exports and logs (tar.gz), and a redacted branch policy JSON.

Questions for you: do you need original log timestamps or are ISO hashes acceptable for redacted runs? Also confirm if you want the data in Drive or a secure upload link.

Thanks — looping in Irene to prepare the CI logs and Grace for branch exports.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance PM
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stub: sdlc_evidence_index.pdf (description of included files)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, grace.oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 07 Dec 2028 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: Evidence — deploy authorization + secret rotation plan

Tessa / Grace — quick internal notes before we package:
- I'll export the CI run from 2028-12-06 (pipeline id 5423) and sanitize runner IPs and agent hostnames. File: ci_job_logs_20281206.tar.gz (contains ci_run_5423.log, vault_token_audit.csv).
- Grace, please include branch_policy_export_202812.json and CODEOWNERS snapshot. Add a short readme that explains which repos are subject to signed commits vs. not.
- For the deploy safelist, include deploy_safelist_snapshot_202812.json and the JIRA ticket ID for the last manual safelist change (RD-1176).
- On the token disclosure question: we should provide event timestamps and token IDs hashed (sha256) rather than raw tokens. Confirmed with SRE — revocations are logged and will be included.

I can deliver the sanitized archive tonight; want to double-check redaction before it goes out to external assessors.

Irene Choi
Principal Engineer, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

> Hi Alice — thanks for the checklist and the clarity...

To: Alice Lane <alice.lane@finbank.com>

Date: Sat, 08 Dec 2028 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence — deploy authorization + secret rotation plan

Alice — attaching the package and links per the plan. We redacted the runner IPs and replaced raw tokens with sha256 hashes. Files included (attachment stubs below and Drive folder link):

Included artifacts (high level):
- sdlc_evidence_index.pdf — index and mapping table to your checklist (contains which files were redacted and why).
- ci_job_logs_20281206.tar.gz — anonymized pipeline logs and vault audit events (pipeline id 5423).
- branch_policy_export_202812.json & CODEOWNERS-export.txt — branch protection rules and CODEOWNERS snapshot for repos in scope.
- deploy_safelist_snapshot_202812.json — current safelist plus last-change ticket (RD-1176).
- deploy_approval_matrix.csv — human approval matrix with role and Slack handle (redacted emails).

Delivery links:
- Drive (shared, view-only, redacted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sdlc-evidence
- HubSpot tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-9821
- DocuSign (access agreement): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF1234567890

Notes:
- We replaced any raw CI tokens with sha256(token) and left timestamps intact (you can correlate issuance and revoke events).
- If you need original logs for forensic review, we'll coordinate an encrypted transfer under an NDA.

Please confirm receipt and whether the level of redaction is acceptable. Happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk through any artifacts.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance PM
Redwood Inference
